title: Light of Creation
symbol: a sun with rays and a crescent moon and stars
summary: God creates light and the world begins — the story that ends at Bethlehem starts here.

title: The Tree and the Fall
symbol: a fruit tree with a serpent coiled around the trunk
summary: Adam and Eve disobey, and God makes the first promise that a Rescuer will come.

title: Noah's Ark
symbol: an ark on waves with a rainbow above it
summary: God saves Noah's family and hangs a rainbow as a promise of mercy.

title: Abraham's Stars
symbol: a night sky full of stars over a small tent
summary: God promises Abraham a family as countless as the stars — and that through it the whole world will be blessed.

title: The Ram for Isaac
symbol: a ram with curled horns standing by a thorn bush
summary: God provides a ram in Isaac's place — a picture of the substitute God will one day provide.

title: Jacob's Ladder
symbol: a ladder reaching up into clouds with a star above
summary: Jacob dreams of a stairway between heaven and earth; Jesus will BE that bridge.

title: Joseph's Coat
symbol: a patterned long-sleeved coat with stripes
summary: Joseph is betrayed and sold, yet God uses it to save many — evil turned to rescue.

title: The Burning Bush
symbol: a bush with flames rising from it, unburned
summary: God calls Moses from the burning bush to lead His people out of slavery.

title: The Passover Lamb
symbol: a lamb standing before a doorframe
summary: The lamb's blood on the doorframe saves Israel — the sign John will echo: 'Behold, the Lamb of God.'

title: The Ten Commandments
symbol: two stone tablets with Roman numerals I to X
summary: God gives His law at Sinai and makes Israel His covenant people.

title: The Trumpet at Jericho
symbol: a curved ram's horn trumpet (shofar)
summary: God brings the walls down — He wins battles His own way.

title: Ruth's Wheat
symbol: a tied bundle of wheat stalks
summary: Ruth's loyalty is woven into the family line of David — and of Jesus.

title: Samuel's Lamp
symbol: a small oil lamp with a flame
summary: The boy Samuel hears God's voice in the night: 'Speak, for your servant is listening.'

title: The Stump of Jesse
symbol: a tree stump with one green shoot growing from it
summary: The prophecy that names the tree: from Jesse's stump, a Branch will bear fruit.

title: David's Harp
symbol: a small wooden harp (lyre)
summary: God chooses the shepherd-singer David — the king whose greater Son is coming.

title: Solomon's Temple
symbol: a temple with pillars and steps
summary: Solomon builds God a house; one day God will come to dwell with us Himself.

title: Elijah's Altar
symbol: an altar of stacked stones with fire falling on it
summary: Fire falls on Carmel and the people cry: 'The LORD — he is God!'

title: Isaiah's Promise
symbol: a scroll unrolled with a single bright star above it
summary: 'For to us a child is born' — seven hundred years early, the birth announcement is written.

title: The New Covenant
symbol: a heart with a small scroll inside it
summary: God promises a new covenant — His law written on hearts, sins remembered no more.

title: Daniel and the Lion
symbol: a friendly lion sitting with closed mouth
summary: God shuts the lions' mouths — faithful trust in a foreign land.

title: Jonah's Great Fish
symbol: a great fish with its mouth open on waves
summary: Three days inside the fish, then out alive — the sign Jesus claimed for Himself.

title: The Voice in the Desert
symbol: a scallop shell with three drops of water
summary: John prepares the way: 'After me comes one more powerful than I.'

title: Mary's Lily
symbol: a lily flower with a small radiant star
summary: Mary says yes: 'I am the Lord's servant. May your word to me be fulfilled.'

title: The Star of Bethlehem
symbol: a large eight-pointed star shining over a tiny town silhouette
summary: The star rises over the little town the prophet named seven centuries before.

title: The Manger
symbol: a manger with swaddled baby and a star above
summary: The Branch from Jesse's stump arrives: Christ the Lord, asleep on the hay.
